rewards.redemption_notes: Avios points earned during a billing cycle will be automatically transferred to your British Airways Club account after the end of each billing cycle. Avios points expire according to British Airways Club program terms (36 consecutive months of inactivity).

signup_bonus.description: Earn 75,000 Avios after you spend $5,000 on purchases within the first 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: 10% Off On British Airways Flights
benefits.description: Take 10% off British Airways flights starting in the US when you book through the website provided in your welcome materials.

benefits.title: Up to $600 Reward Flight Statement Credits
benefits.description: Receive statement credits of $100 for Economy and Premium Economy or $200 for Business and First Class seats, three times per year, up to $600, when you book a Reward Flight travelling on British Airways and pay taxes, fees and carrier charges with the card.

benefits.title: Travel Together Ticket
benefits.description: Earn a Travel Together Ticket every calendar year you make $30,000 in purchases on your British Airways credit card. Valid for two years when you redeem Avios for a flight on British Airways for a companion traveling on the same flight, or use it for a 50% discount on the Avios price when booking a solo reward flight.

benefits.title: Paying with Avios
benefits.description: British Airways Visa Signature cardmembers can pay for the taxes, fees and carrier charges for flights using Avios. Must make reward booking via British Airways Club Contact Centre.

benefits.title: Complimentary DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Get one-year complimentary DashPass membership for both DoorDash and Caviar. Activate by Dec 31, 2027.

benefits.title: Chase Pay Over Time
benefits.description: Break up credit card purchases into budget friendly payments. After purchase: pay off eligible purchases of $100 or more in smaller equal monthly payments. No interest, just a fixed monthly fee.
